summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint and phased implementation plan for the AIONOS Airport KPI Intelligence App (Code: ZZA), detailing in-browser PostgreSQL WASM (PGlite) persistence, 26 conformed dimensions and 54 fact tables, 624-KPI library calculation engine, seamless RBAC authentication across 24 roles, all 20 departmental dashboards, TanStack Query data layer, and AIONOS light/dark design system.
